entries.basis: Three firsthand January2015 pre-release HoloLens prototype demonstrations, not retail/2016 Developer Edition/2019 HoloLens2. Jessi Hempel/WIRED, Ars Staff/Ars Technica, Ben Gilbert/Engadget. Praise for holographic visuals and criticism of prototype comfort are retained. Wired and Ars share CondeNast ownership; the WiredUK Ars republication is excluded as a duplicate. Publisher-local Jan21 publication days verified; Ars structured UTC Jan22 is the next-day UTC conversion of Jan21 US publication, not a second review. Corded development rigs and controlled demos do not establish retail comfort, battery life or long-term reliability.
